newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - Albright & Wilson costs plateau.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Albright & Wilson costs plateau.

text.p: Specialty chemicals group Albright & Wilson Plc said on Thursday that raw material cost rises have plateaued, but there is little sign of them falling.

Despite continuing high prices, Albright & Wilson, the world's biggest producer of purified phosphoric acid, lifted interim pretax profit by 6.3 percent to 32.0 million pounds amid continuing strong competition.

In a telephone interview with Reuters, chief executive Robin Paul said raw material costs added 40 million stg to bills in 1995 as a whole. "That has now plateaued, but there is no significant benefit from them coming back."
